## Checklist

From [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/mcosgriff/flyway-bracket/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests):

- [ ] The branch is named `<type>/<topic>` (`feat/outing-flow`, `fix/seed-order`) and is not `main`.
- [ ] The pull request title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, …).
- [ ] `./gradlew build` is green.
- [ ] A change people would notice updates `README.md` in this pull request.
- [ ] Test data is made up: no real personal data and no real bird figures.
- [ ] This is not a security problem. Those go through a private report: see [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/mcosgriff/flyway-bracket/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
